name: AI Deep Dive — CIFR — 2026-05-02
rationale: CIFR (Cipher Digital) is executing an aggressive HPC/AI data center pivot from its legacy bitcoin mining roots. The valuation ($6.9B on $224M revenue = 30x P/S) is pricing in massive hyperscaler tenant demand. However, with trailing FCF at a deeply negative -$702M, the capital required to build out these sites will necessitate substantial equity dilution. My weighted fair value of $6.02 reflects a 65% downside risk due to the sheer volume of capital required to scale.

aiThesis.rationale: Cipher is facing the same structural reality as other crypto-to-HPC transition plays: the capital expenditure required to host hyperscalers is astronomical. Last year they generated $224M in revenue but burned $702M in free cash flow. Funding this gap at a $6.9B market cap means significant dilution is incoming (estimated 40% in base case). Even if they successfully scale HPC revenue at a 55% CAGR over 5 years with a 12% net margin, the resulting cash flows divided by a bloated share count yield a $5.92 present value. The 30x current trailing sales multiple offers no margin of safety.
